Content: A small digital clock can be powered by a battery made from `text(two)` potatoes and some household materials. The “potato clock” battery consists of `text(two)` cells connected in a way to produce enough electricity to allow the clock to operate. In `text(each cell)`, zinc atoms react to form zinc ions. Hydrogen ions from phosphoric acid in the potatoes react to form hydrogen gas.
